      Privacy & offline
      Walks, observations, and photos are saved in this browser. Gemma is a text model: it does not analyze your photos. You can export notes and inference evidence.
      First use downloads the model from Hugging Face. Later inference runs on your device. This app includes its own runtime; there is no hosted inference API.
      Preparing offline app storage…
      Clearing browser storage also clears this journal and downloaded model. Device voices depend on your installed speech pack.
